versions.changelog:
- Added a metadata header (name and description) at the top of SKILL.md for clearer identification and description of the skill.
- Description now highlights features such as AI-powered hooks, fast testing cycles, and use cases in both English and Chinese.
- No changes to core functionality or usage instructions; update is documentation-focused.

- Added a new README.md file to the project.
- Updated the SKILL.md upgrade link from mediaclaw.ai to mediaclawbot.com.

Initial release of Ad Video Creator skill:

- Generate ready-to-upload video ads from product photos, brand assets, or existing footage.
- Automatically write hooks, captions, and CTAs optimized for TikTok, Meta, Google, and Xiaohongshu ads.
- Output in multiple formats (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) and create 5–10 creative variants for A/B testing.
- Compliance with ad platform specs and usage of proven ad frameworks (PAS, AIDA, storytelling, UGC, and trending formats).
- Includes overlays, end cards, and conversion-focused copy for higher click-through rates.
